name: Imouto Rape ~Imouto no Konamaiki na Biniku~
original_name: 妹レイプ ～妹の小生意気な媚肉～
source:
Main character is being bullied by his younger sister. She walks the house in underwear not considering brother a man. Finally he bursts out and half-way insults her. But why does she not actively resist? Was all that teasing on purpose?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角被妹妹欺负。她穿着内衣在家里走来走去，根本不把弟弟当作男人。最后他突然爆发并半途侮辱了她。但她为什么不积极反抗呢？所有这些都是故意戏弄的吗？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
